name: sk-token-meter
title: Token Meter
description: Quota usage that changes colour at 70% and 90%, where the copy changes and the upgrade action appears. A prompt to upgrade at 15% is an advert; the same prompt at 92% is help. The fill glides rather than snapping, so an expensive action is visibly expensive.
author: Ahmed Gagan
usage:
SKTokenMeter(used: 18_420, limit: 25_000)
SKTokenMeter(used: used, limit: limit, style: .compact, onUpgrade: upgrade)
